fact: The final evaluation of Enabel's PARECIGUI Phase 2 (June 2026) reports that more than 445,000 civil records were migrated into the central E-RENEC base but interoperability had not been activated, so the ONI/PN-RAVEC identification base is not yet fed from civil registration data to assign the NPI automatically.
title: Evaluation du Projet pilote d'amélioration du système d'état civil guinéen par l'effet catalyseur de la digitalisation (PARECIGUI Ext Phase 2)
